headline: Tarique to deliver maiden speech at UNGA on Sept 24

members.title: Tarique to deliver maiden speech at UNGA on Sept 24
members.lead: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will arrive in New York today to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, where he will deliver his maiden speech as Bangladesh’s head of government at the General Debate on September 24.His speech is expected to focus on Bangladesh’s democratic transformation, national interests, economic reconstruction, investment and employment, climate justice, the Rohingya crisis, world peace and multilateral cooperation.Officials said the Prime Minister would highlight Bangladesh’s new political reality, future development priorities and the need for greater international cooperation.The visit carries added significance as Foreign Minister Dr Khalilur Rahman is serving as president

members.title: PM heads to New York at Dawn for UNGA summit
